topics.title: Portfolio Construction, Management, and Assessment
topics.objective: The candidate will understand portfolio construction, management, and assessment.

outcomes.text: Describe the portfolio management process and recommend investment governance structure
Develop an investment policy statement (IPS) for an institutional investor
Demonstrate an understanding of portfolio construction approaches and techniques for asset allocation, passive/active management and rebalancing
Recommend and justify an optimal portfolio allocation in a risk-return framework
Demonstrate an understanding of common techniques to enhance yield and manage liquidity in fixed income portfolios
Construct and manage portfolios of fixed income investments under various strategies, including indexing and target return
Construct and manage portfolios of equity under various passive strategies
Construct and manage portfolios of equity under various active strategies
Apply performance measurement methodologies to various asset portfolios
Describe and assess techniques to select or build an asset benchmark for a given investment objective
Assess and interpret performance attribution metrics for a given asset or portfolio
Understand how behavior bias can impact portfolio management

topics.objective: The candidate will understand the best practices of credit risk management.

outcomes.text: Demonstrate an understanding of credit risk analysis including at the portfolio level
Demonstrate an understanding of and the ability to apply both the concepts and techniques used in the measurement of default risk of individual securities
Understand, evaluate, and apply credit risk modeling techniques.
